verdict.rationale: A probe found an OpenAPI document at pydantic.dev/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key), so a downloadable machine-readable spec exists on the vendor's domain. Nothing shows it describes Pydantic AI, which is a Python library, rather than another Pydantic service. The machine-readable llms.txt and .md docs help agents read the documentation but are not an API spec. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the OpenAPI spec and its scope, confirmation it covers Pydantic AI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of its use.
